name: @occluze/tether-sync
description: Shopify -> Webflow CMS sync for Tether: webhooks, reconcile cron and initial import. Runs as a Cloudflare Worker or a Node CLI.
author: Ravi Klaassens

SHOPIFY_DOMAIN.description: **Required.** Your store's `.myshopify.com` domain, e.g. `your-store.myshopify.com` (not your custom domain).

WEBFLOW_COLLECTION_ID.description: **Required.** Id of the Webflow Products collection (24 characters; Webflow CMS → collection settings).

WEBFLOW_TOKEN.description: **Required.** Webflow site API token with **CMS read and write** (Site settings → Apps & integrations → API access).

SHOPIFY_CLIENT_ID.description: Client id of a Shopify [Dev Dashboard](https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/build/dev-dashboard) app installed on your store, with `read_products`. Fill this and the secret, **or** SHOPIFY_ADMIN_TOKEN.

SHOPIFY_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Client secret of that app. Also verifies the webhooks.

SHOPIFY_ADMIN_TOKEN.description: Only for an existing admin-created custom app: its `shpat_…` token. Leave empty when you use a Dev Dashboard app.

SHOPIFY_WEBHOOK_SECRET.description: Optional. Only for webhooks created under Shopify Settings → Notifications: the signing key shown there. Leave empty to use the client secret.

SYNC_SECRET.description: Optional. A random string of **at least 24 characters** (e.g. from a password manager). Unlocks the API tests on `/check` and `POST /reconcile`. Empty: both stay off.

FIELD_MAP.description: Optional. JSON to change the field mapping, e.g. `{"material":"metafield:custom.material"}`. Leave empty for the default mapping.
